_readme: Every photographic or video section on the site reads from this file. To add footage: put the files in site/assets/video/, fill in 'video' (and optionally 'videoMobile', 'poster'), then run npm run build. 'photo' is a genuine Marpet photograph from site/assets/img; 'still' is a path under site/assets/ for a crop made by tools/cine.py. 'mode' is 'loop' (plays while on screen) or 'scrub' (scroll moves through the clip). 'brief' says what to film. See docs/footage.md.

brief.shot: TIG welding stainless steel, extreme close-up
brief.detail: The arc lighting the steel and the welder's glove. Slow slide along the seam. Shoot the same seam wide afterwards.

brief.shot: Finished weld or brushed frame with the Marpet plate, close
brief.detail: Slow slide along a finished conveyor side frame, ending on the Marpet logo plate. Raking light from one side.

home-reveal.use: Homepage opening, pull back (headline arrives here)
home-reveal.alt: Long stainless steel belt conveyor by Marpet in a food production hall

brief.shot: Wide pull back from the welder to the whole workshop
brief.detail: Same scene as the welding close-up, revealed wide: benches, stock, work in progress. Lights on, doors closed, no clutter in the foreground.
Tape and square on sheet or on site, a drawing on the bench, a hand marking a line. Close and medium shots.
brief.where: Workshop or a client site (with permission)

home-workshop.use: Homepage scroll, chapter 2: Made in the workshop

brief.detail: Folding or cutting sheet, grinding and dressing a weld, fitting a frame together. Sparks welcome. Several short takes.

home-site.use: Homepage scroll, chapter 3: Installed on site

brief.shot: Installation and a finished line running
brief.detail: Fitting a section at a client site, then the finished conveyor or line running with product. Needs the client's written permission.
A slow move across the workshop with several jobs on the go.
Slow move along a finished, installed line with product on it. Needs the client's written permission.

brief.shot: Clyde Workshops: the yard, a van loading, the workshop door
brief.detail: Establishing shots of the premises and a job leaving for site.
Hands, tools and faces at work. Only people who have agreed to appear.
A slow, calm shot: light on a finished bench or a stack of sheet. Text sits over it, so keep the left side simple.

brief.shot: A fabricator at the bench, then fitting on site
brief.detail: Medium shot of hands and tools at work in the workshop, then the same job being fitted at a client site.
brief.where: Marpet workshop and a client site (with permission)
